title: 第四章 坑货系统-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》
content:
第(1/3)页

    听到爻雪的吐槽，系统的声音十分理直气壮的说道：

    【宿主不要在意这些细节，难道你不知道，基础打的越好，未来的成就就会越高吗？我这时在帮你】

    “那我是不是还要谢谢你啊。”爻雪面无表情的说道。

    【不客气，这都是本系统应该做的】

    听到这毫不客气的话，爻雪不由的有些无语，自己的这个系统，感觉有点欠欠的。

    不过，相较于之前那个冷冰冰的面板，她还是更加喜欢这个系统，起码，有人陪她说话了。

    “对了系统，你知道我是为什么穿越过来的吗？”

    爻雪一边朝着店铺里面走去一边问道，这也是她最好奇的事情了。

    按照小说里面的套路，想要穿越肯定是要在另外一个世界经历什么危机生命的事情才行，比如被车撞，自杀，绝症等等，可她很确定，自己什么都没有做，也没有遇到什么危险，一睁眼，她就这么水灵灵的穿越了。

    【这件事本系统也不清楚，不过，既然事情已经发生了，又何必再纠结过去呢】

    闻言，爻雪点了点头，“你说的对，过好现在才是最要紧的，过去的事情都已经过去了。”

    就在爻雪跟系统聊天的时候，天空忽然传来一声巨响，血雨闪亮登场。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Hearing Yaoxue’s complaints, the system’s voice said very confidently:

【Host, don’t worry about these details, don’t you know that the better the foundation is, the higher your future achievements will be?I’m helping you right now]

"Then do I still want to thank you?" Yaoxue said expressionlessly.

【You're welcome, this is what this system should do】

Hearing these unceremonious words, Yaoxue couldn't help but feel a little speechless. This system of hers felt a little indebted.

However, compared to the cold panel before, she still likes this system more. At least, she has someone to talk to her.

"By the way, system, do you know why I traveled through time?"

Yaoxue asked as she walked towards the store. This was also the thing she was most curious about.

According to the routine in the novel, if you want to time travel, you must experience something life-threatening in another world, such as being hit by a car, committing suicide, terminal illness, etc., but she is very sure that she has done nothing and has not encountered any danger. As soon as she opens her eyes, she has time traveled so easily.

【The system is not clear about this matter, but since it has already happened, why bother worrying about it anymore】

Hearing this, Yaoxue nodded, "You are right, living well now is the most important thing, the past is in the past."

Just as Yaoxue was chatting with the system, a loud noise suddenly came from the sky, and a rain of blood appeared.
